About the job
Spreeline Mobility builds software for public transport operators.

Your responsibilities
Own the month-end closing and the annual financial statements under HGB
Prepare the monthly reporting for the management team
Coordinate the annual audit

Requirements
At least 5 years of professional experience in accounting or controlling
Experience with month-end closing under HGB
Good knowledge of DATEV
Fluent German and English

Why join us
30 days of vacation and a company pension scheme
A modern office in Berlin-Kreuzberg with flexible working hours
Please confirm that you hold a valid work permit for Germany.
